text:
I was at macdonalds Piccadilly Gardens today 30th Aug nearly 5 o'clock and ordered chips and two slushy. One was Spanish punch or something and it was large but only ice and tiny bit of juice. I asked at the counter and miss zurnish was very rude with me to prove it full large glass of slushy even blind can see it was half full of ice. Both my kids were hungry and I didn't want any scene to create but it's our favourite and we can't see this happened to macdonald. My kids were tired and hungry and I didn't have more money to buy another glass to quench the thirst my kids have.
It's horrible to see pathetic service by miss so called zurnish.and the other which didn't have name on her uniform and don't want to give a name after this sort of moon rocking stupidity and pathetic behaviour by these two clowns.
author: Khursheed Bygum

text: I receieved this at Mcdonalds today. (See photo.) I visited this McDonald's today and had a terrible experience. I was reduced to tears after being humiliated in public by Erica who was rude. I was served a pile of slop by Erica who was wearing a blouse and a red bow. I was spoken to awfully and this experience has left me shaken and upset. I had a bad feeling after ordering and waiting ages on end. Erica could see I had been waiting a long time and everyone else's food was served to a normal standard. When I received my order it looked half eaten. I don't recommend this McDonald's. I feel that because of the way I look I have been stereotyped and treated unfairly.
author: X

text: Worst McDonald's experience I've had in a long time. The manager (male, spikey hair) was shouting and being horrible to all the staff. I realise it was very busy but there is no need to be nasty to all of the staff. Huffing and puffing under his breath. It meant staff were going faster than they should, someone spilt a bit of a drink and he got annoyed. My order was wrong twice but I didn't care anymore. The sprite didn't have any syrup so it's just fizzy water. Genuinely concerned for the management of this place. It would have been better to wait longer and get the right order and not see young staff being stressed and upset.
author: Amelia

text:
How do you forget someone parked right outside your window?
Pulled into the drive-thru, placed a simple order, got told to park up — fair enough. Then I sat there. And sat there. And sat there some more. After 45 minutes (yes, forty-five minutes) I had to actually go inside and chase my own food. Turns out they’d completely forgotten the order existed. No apology, no urgency, just a shrug and a cold bag shoved my way.
For a place built on “fast” food, this was anything but. If I’d planted a potato when I pulled up, it’d have been ready to harvest by the time I finally got my fries.
Won’t be back to this branch anytime soon.
author: Fenn Settle

text:
Recently, there have been many homeless individuals coming into the restaurant, especially around 7 AM, when several of them enter and approach customers. They often ask customers for food or drinks, and when someone offers to buy for them, they choose the most expensive drink on the menu. This whole situation makes me feel unsafe and uncomfortable every time I visit.

The atmosphere in the store is no longer pleasant, and it has made me less willing to come to this branch. I hope the management improves the safety and environment soon.
author: J. B

text:
The manager at the front counter at 4pm today called Alan was extremely rude to his coworkers think the powers gotten to his head, was ripping receipts out of peoples hands and was very belittling.

Also we heard him say to an employee not to give us all the sauces we asked for, when we asked for them we were told we would have to pay for them. I also work at mcdonalds and know this is not the right procedure.

the dining area staff were absolutely lovely! shame about the management though
author: James Green

text: I ordered a veg burger meal and the thing they gave me was no where near what was on display. Soggy chips, no salt, no sauce. They charge extra for large meal and the burger was just small. Only drink and chips were bit more. Normal portion are about 15 to 18 pieces of small freanh fries and large are about 20 to 25 pieces. No customer service,  feels like robots working there. Its really shamefull what i got for £4.90. Properly waste of money.
author: Kashif Choudhry

text: Easily one of the worst McDonald’s in the UK. You’re always greeted by hoards of Homeless / Spiced / Drugged up people stood in the doorway, pestering customers. Then when inside, the atmosphere and quality of food is shocking and abysmal. Not forgetting the delinquent wanna be ghetto teens your met with playing load music, shouting, being rude etc. The management don’t even bother trying to make it better been like it for years now.
author: R

text:
Some weirdo guy working at the kitchen on 17 Feb at 10pm came up to the collection counter to ask me if I was Indian. Obviously confused by the question I didn’t answer. What do we expect from Piccadilly gardens. Both the staff and the customers are wierd. Very unprofessional.

Aside from that the other workers were alright, maybe a few screws loose who knows.
author: Sarah

text:
The service was quick considering how many people were there, but there was so many people you could barely move past them let alone sit down.

I ordered a drink and there was something in it so I threw out the drink; didn't bother to try and get a new one since it was so busy.

text: Packed items incorrectly. Forgot one of my items. Extremely frustrating as the staff weren’t even busy. It was a quiet Sunday night.  Paid money and asked for two items. Only received one. Absolute joke of a McDonald’s. Picadilly gardens. Won’t ever be returning.

text: Very poor service attitude. On Sunday afternoon (5th October), a tall male staff member wearing a white shirt was extremely rude and impatient. He even lost his temper with customers. Very disappointing experience.

text: Mcdonalds is mcdonalds wherever you go to eat but time after time after time at piccadilly the food comes out cold,the wraps look like they have been put together by primary school kids,really bad food prep.
